title: 能力必须由真实输出证明，而非名称/返回码声明
summary: 硬件编码器、字幕渲染、Native bridge 等能力不能因为 API 名称存在、encoder 被枚举或 FFmpeg 返回成功就视为可用；需要产生并验证真正体现目标能力的输出。
invariants: Enumerated capability or encoder name is evidence of possibility, not successful execution.
Initialization success or process return code is insufficient when the desired visual/media effect can silently fail.
A capability smoke test SHOULD create a minimal output and validate it with an independent observer.
Device/vendor dependent acceleration remains opt-in until device-specific smoke evidence exists.
Observed capability evidence is scoped to the tested runtime/device/configuration.

provenance.note: resource existence does not imply final font face/render hit.
